business_summary: Adventure, Inc. operates an online travel reservation platform under the skyticket name. It offers air ticket booking, local tours, private lodging management, and offshore development services. The company is also involved in technology development hub; Wi-Fi rental and sales, as well as eSIM sales; and development hub for IT services. Adventure, Inc. was formerly known as Cyber Travel Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Adventure Inc. in June 2013. Adventure, Inc. was founded in 2004 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.
